product: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Purge Catcher — Interface Neuentwurf

scope.intended_use: Ein leichter Fangkopf fährt direkt mit dem Purge-Wiper entlang Z, fängt Filamentreste unmittelbar an der Quelle und lenkt sie ohne langen Kanal nach unten in einen stationären, entnehmbaren Sammelbehälter.
scope.user_context: Betreiber eines Anycubic Kobra 3 Max; die konkrete Maschine ist durch eigene Fotos und Benutzermessungen dokumentiert, Serien-/Revisionskennung und vollständige Maschinenhüllkurve bleiben unbekannt.
out_of_scope: Claims not explicitly supported by the cited repository evidence
Production release without closure of blocking gates

entities.name: Anycubic Kobra 3 Max Purge Catcher — Interface Neuentwurf

dimensions.feature: Vertical centre-to-centre pitch of the two user-measured Wiper screws
Primary interface envelope and functional allowance

evidence.uncertainty_note: The exact Kobra 3 Max variant and 17 mm screw pitch are supported, including an installed third-party reference, but the clean-room accessory envelope, screw hardware, tolerances and full machine-motion keep-outs remain unverified.

failure_modes.mode: Primary interface does not meet fit or functional intent
failure_modes.effect: Loss of intended function and the credible failure effects recorded at product level
failure_modes.mitigation: Confirm the exact variant, measure the interface, define tolerances, and test a coupon or controlled prototype.

acceptance_criteria: A clean-room 17 mm hole-pattern and conservative outline coupon fits the powered-off target machine without interference.
The complete installed accessory and service sweep retain the approved clearance over the full powered-off machine-motion envelope.

drivers: INT=3: At least one functional host, human, medium, or assembly boundary governs success.
MOT=2: The accessory co-moves with the Purge-Wiper along the guided Z translation.
PHY=3: Load, heat, airflow, water, fatigue, or another functional physical domain must be tested.
VER=3: Several fit, function, flow, load, motion, or process checks are required.

blocking_unknowns: clean-room machine envelope, screw hardware, tolerances and uncertainty beyond the independently measured 17 mm pitch
architecture decision between a lightweight diverter with stationary storage and a directly mounted moving storage bin

criticality.rationale: The product involves load, flow, motion, heat-adjacent use, or direct body contact and therefore requires controlled functional testing.

decision.rationale: The installed third-party reference materially improves variant, side, orientation and two-screw-interface evidence, but it cannot supply clean-room geometry or commercial rights. R7 remains held until its own envelope, hardware and architecture are approved and physically checked.

warnings.message: The exact host variant and 17 mm screw pitch are supported, but the clean-room accessory still lacks a complete machine envelope, hardware contract, tolerances and physical coupon result.
The strongest fit reference is marked BY-NC and may not be copied into a commercial R7 design; its exact license version is not embedded.
The reference 3MF embeds a Bambu Lab P1S profile, not an Anycubic Kobra 3 Max manufacturing profile.

next_actions.action: Build and fit a clean-room 17 mm hole-pattern plus conservative outline coupon from the user's own measurements and machine photos.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The coupon fits the powered-off target machine, screw hardware and engagement are recorded, and no third-party contour or dimension is used.

next_actions.action: Select the storage architecture before reopening concept approval.
next_actions.exit_criterion: The owner explicitly approves either lightweight moving diversion with stationary storage or directly mounted moving storage, including the corresponding moving-mass and service constraints.

next_actions.action: Verify the complete machine-motion and service envelope with the selected clean-room concept.
next_actions.exit_criterion: Powered-off full-travel, tool-access and removal-sweep tests meet the documented clearance criteria.
